Title: Perpetual free tier offering for Linux-based applications on App Service

Body.Content:
If you’re running web apps on Linux, you now have an easy and free on-ramp with Azure App Service. The new, free tier for Linux applications is perpetually free, meaning it won’t expire after one month. It’s an easy and low-cost way to experiment and host your Linux-based web apps on App Service before fully investing.

Learn more
